feedbackScope: Sound and particle constants are declarations in each adaptation source; presets and delegated helpers can emit additional feedback. Declarations are expected candidates, not evidence of activation or rendering.

adaptations.name: agility-wind-up

adaptations.expectation: Projectiles can pin targets with heavy slowness.

adaptations.name: ranged-recovery
adaptations.expectation: Chance to recover arrows after hitting or killing an enemy.

adaptations.name: ranged-ricochet-bolt
adaptations.expectation: Projectiles ricochet from block impacts with chained bounces, scaling speed, and bonus damage.

adaptations.name: ranged-trajectory-sight
adaptations.expectation: Preview ranged projectile flight while sneaking or drawing your shot.

adaptations.name: ranged-webshot
adaptations.expectation: Throw a crafted web snare to trap targets in cobwebs.

adaptations.name: rift-access
adaptations.expectation: Craft a Reliquary Portkey to access marked containers remotely.

adaptations.name: rift-blink
adaptations.expectation: Blink with player-selectable activation, targeting and phasing. Reactive activation unlocks at level 2 and replaces double-jump with an attack dodge. Successful blinks deal level-scaled ender pearl damage.

adaptations.name: rift-conduit
adaptations.expectation: Bind two containers with paired taglocks; items placed in one flow to the other, and cross dimensions at max level.

adaptations.name: rift-descent
adaptations.expectation: Sneak to descend and negate levitation effects.

adaptations.name: rift-ender-taglock
adaptations.expectation: Tag entities into ender pearls and throw those pearls to reposition the tagged target.

adaptations.name: rift-enderchest
adaptations.expectation: Open an enderchest by left-clicking it in your hand.

adaptations.name: rift-gate
adaptations.expectation: Craft a gate item to teleport to a marked location.

adaptations.name: rift-inflated-pocket-dimension
adaptations.expectation: Building and empty-hand block targeting can fetch materials from your ender chest, and sneak-drop stores items into it.

adaptations.name: rift-pearl-rebound
adaptations.expectation: Plain thrown pearls bounce once off the first surface toward your crosshair, and their ender pearl landing damage is reduced.

adaptations.name: rift-resist
adaptations.expectation: Gain resistance when using Ender items and abilities.

adaptations.name: rift-visage
adaptations.expectation: Prevents Endermen from becoming aggressive when you carry Enderpearls.

adaptations.name: rift-void-magnet
adaptations.expectation: Sneak to periodically pull nearby dropped items into your ender chest first.

adaptations.name: rift-void-skin
adaptations.expectation: Any lethal damage blinks you to a nearby safe spot, or the current world's spawn when none exists, with brief resistance for one ender pearl.

adaptations.name: seaborne-brine-skin
adaptations.expectation: While wet you slowly regenerate and take reduced damage, and the buff lingers briefly after you dry off.

adaptations.name: seaborne-coral-gardener
adaptations.expectation: Coral you place survives out of water far longer, bonemeal grows coral, and reef blocks grant bonus XP.

adaptations.name: seaborne-deep-salvager
adaptations.expectation: Underwater containers privately glow within range and reward bonus treasure the first time you open them submerged.

adaptations.name: seaborne-fish-whisperer
adaptations.expectation: Fish school toward you, dolphins and axolotls assist your hunts, and you fish with a permanent Luck of the Sea tier.

adaptations.name: seaborne-fishers-fantasy
adaptations.expectation: Fishing can grant one bounded bonus item, vanilla XP, and Seaborne XP.

adaptations.name: seaborne-hydro-jet
adaptations.expectation: Tap sneak while swimming to burst forward on a jet of water. Costs hunger and consumes a charge.

adaptations.name: seaborne-ink-veil
adaptations.expectation: Taking damage underwater bursts an ink cloud that blinds hostiles and briefly hides you from drowned and guardians.

adaptations.name: seaborne-oxygen
adaptations.expectation: Hold more oxygen underwater.

adaptations.name: seaborne-pressure-diver
adaptations.expectation: Gain absorption hearts and depth-scaling protection underwater while partially countering mining fatigue.

adaptations.name: seaborne-speed
adaptations.expectation: Swim faster with dolphin-like grace.

adaptations.name: seaborne-tidecaller
adaptations.expectation: Sneak while it is raining to dash like a water blink through the storm.

adaptations.name: seaborne-trident-mastery
adaptations.expectation: Tridents deal bonus damage and home back to you faster after a throw.

adaptations.name: seaborne-turtles-mining-speed
adaptations.expectation: Mine faster while underwater, with optional compensation for the vanilla floating penalty.

adaptations.name: seaborne-turtles-vision
adaptations.expectation: Gain night vision while underwater.

adaptations.name: stealth-assassinate
adaptations.expectation: While Stealth reports you undetected, a strike instantly executes non-boss mobs below a max-health cap.

adaptations.name: stealth-cutpurse
adaptations.expectation: While Stealth reports you undetected, hits on pillagers, vindicators, and piglins can steal loot without a kill.

adaptations.name: stealth-decoy-swap
adaptations.expectation: Requires Shadow Decoy. While your decoy is alive, double-tap sneak to swap places with it.

adaptations.name: stealth-enderveil
adaptations.expectation: Prevent Enderman aggression without wearing a pumpkin.

adaptations.name: stealth-ghost-armor
adaptations.expectation: Slowly build armor when not taking damage, consumed on the next hit.

adaptations.name: stealth-shadow-decoy
adaptations.expectation: Stopping sneak spawns a short-lived shadow decoy that pulls your current aggro.

adaptations.name: stealth-shadowmeld
adaptations.expectation: Remain sneaking and undetected to become invisible; detection, acting, taking damage, or standing ends the meld.

adaptations.name: stealth-silent-step
adaptations.expectation: Core stealth detection. Sneaking uses observer awareness, while invisibility or an active Shadow Decoy always counts as undetected.

adaptations.name: stealth-smoke-pellet
adaptations.expectation: Sneak while holding gunpowder in either hand to cast a smoke cloud that conceals players, blinds living entities, and clears mob aggression.

adaptations.name: stealth-snatch
adaptations.expectation: Snatch dropped items instantly while sneaking.

adaptations.name: stealth-speed
adaptations.expectation: Gain speed while sneaking, up to the vanilla sneak-speed cap of full walk speed.

adaptations.name: stealth-trap-sense
adaptations.expectation: While sneaking, nearby trapped chests, tripwires, hooks, pressure plates, and sculk blocks glow; maximum level suppresses all movement vibrations.

adaptations.name: stealth-umbral-recovery
adaptations.expectation: Kills made while sneaking refund hunger and extend any active invisibility window.

adaptations.name: stealth-vision
adaptations.expectation: While sneaking, gain night vision, ignore blindness, and see invisible players outlined through Stealth Vision.

adaptations.name: sword-blade-flow
adaptations.expectation: Consecutive sword hits build attack-speed stacks; taking damage breaks the flow.

adaptations.name: sword-bloody-blade
adaptations.expectation: Sword strikes cause bleeding over time.

adaptations.name: sword-crescent-guard
adaptations.expectation: Killing blows with a sword grant brief absorption hearts.

adaptations.name: sword-crimson-cyclone
adaptations.expectation: Land a sword crit while falling to unleash a bleeding crimson cyclone around your target.

adaptations.name: sword-dual-wield
adaptations.expectation: Wield a sword in both hands for increased damage output.

adaptations.name: sword-duelists-focus
adaptations.expectation: Bonus damage and damage reduction while exactly one hostile is engaged with you.

adaptations.name: sword-executioners-edge
adaptations.expectation: Sword strikes deal bonus damage to low-health targets.

adaptations.name: sword-hamstring
adaptations.expectation: Hitting a sprinting or fleeing target slows it and briefly stops it sprinting.

adaptations.name: sword-heirloom-edge
adaptations.expectation: Name a sword at an anvil to make it an heirloom that banks a tiny permanent damage bonus every few kills.

adaptations.name: sword-lunge-strike
adaptations.expectation: Sprint-attacking with a sword lunges you into the strike with extra reach.

adaptations.name: sword-machete
adaptations.expectation: Cut through foliage with ease using a sword.

adaptations.name: sword-poison-blade
adaptations.expectation: Sword strikes apply poison.

adaptations.name: sword-riposte-window
adaptations.expectation: Blocking with a shield arms a short riposte window for your next sword strike.

adaptations.name: sword-whetstone-ritual
adaptations.expectation: Sneak-right-click a grindstone with a sword to grind a temporary sharpness buff for durability and XP.

adaptations.name: tame-alphas-command
adaptations.expectation: Sneak-left-click a target while holding a bone to make your nearby pets focus it.

adaptations.name: tame-battle-bond
adaptations.expectation: When one of your pets lands a kill, you and the nearby pack gain brief strength, speed, and regeneration.

adaptations.name: tame-beast-recall
adaptations.expectation: Sneak-right-click with a lead to recall your nearest tamed companion.

adaptations.name: tame-damage
adaptations.expectation: Increase your tamed animal damage dealt.

adaptations.name: tame-fetch
adaptations.expectation: Your idle tamed wolves physically run to nearby dropped items, pick them up, and carry them back.

adaptations.name: tame-guardian-instinct
adaptations.expectation: Nearby pets leap to intercept projectiles aimed at you, taking reduced damage themselves.

adaptations.name: tame-health
adaptations.expectation: Increase your tamed animal maximum health.

adaptations.name: tame-health-regeneration
adaptations.expectation: Increase your tamed animal regeneration rate.

adaptations.name: tame-last-breath
adaptations.expectation: On a lethal hit a pet drops to 1 HP, is briefly invulnerable, and recalls to your side.

adaptations.name: tame-mounted-tactics
adaptations.expectation: Gain mount-specific combat and control bonuses while riding.

adaptations.name: tame-pack-leader-aura
adaptations.expectation: Nearby tamed companions gain speed and regeneration near their owner.

adaptations.name: tame-shared-pain
adaptations.expectation: Spread part of your incoming damage across nearby owned companions without reducing them below their health floor.

adaptations.name: tame-stable-hand
adaptations.expectation: Animals you tame or breed keep a permanent bias toward better speed, jump, health, and safe fall distance.

adaptations.name: tame-wild-empathy
adaptations.expectation: Taming succeeds more often, and neutral mobs are slower to anger at you.

adaptations.name: tragoul-blood-pact
adaptations.expectation: Losing at least 2 hearts after damage mitigation can trigger temporary beneficial effects.

adaptations.name: tragoul-bone-harvest
adaptations.expectation: Kills can spawn temporary blood and bone globes that grant short buffs when picked up.

adaptations.name: tragoul-corpse-explosion
adaptations.expectation: Mobs you kill detonate in a blood nova that damages nearby hostile mobs.

adaptations.name: tragoul-curse-of-frailty
adaptations.expectation: Enemies that strike you are cursed with weakness, and slowness at higher levels.

adaptations.name: tragoul-death-sense
adaptations.expectation: Weakened living targets near you glow through walls with a color based on their remaining health.

adaptations.name: tragoul-globe
adaptations.expectation: Spread your damage among all nearby enemies.

adaptations.name: tragoul-healing
adaptations.expectation: Every eligible attacker that damages you loses a small fixed amount of life, which is restored to you.

adaptations.name: tragoul-lance
adaptations.expectation: Killing an enemy spawns a lance that seeks and damages a nearby enemy.

adaptations.name: tragoul-last-rites
adaptations.expectation: A killing blow leaves you at 1 HP as a fleeting spirit instead of dying.

adaptations.name: tragoul-marrow-armor
adaptations.expectation: Consume a bone from your inventory to absorb part of incoming damage.

adaptations.name: tragoul-plague-bearer
adaptations.expectation: Mobs that die poisoned or withered by you spread an amplified affliction to nearby damageable mobs.

adaptations.name: tragoul-skeletal-servant
adaptations.expectation: Sneak right-click with bones to raise a pack of temporary skeletal servants that gear up with your level, inherit your Tragoul perks, and hunt whatever you strike or whoever strikes you.

adaptations.name: tragoul-soul-siphon
adaptations.expectation: Every valid damage source attributed to you heals you for part of its final damage, capped per second.

adaptations.name: tragoul-thorns
adaptations.expectation: Reflect damage back to your attacker.

adaptations.name: unarmed-battering-charge
adaptations.expectation: Sprint into enemies with fists or a shield to deal impact damage.

adaptations.name: unarmed-combo-chain
adaptations.expectation: Consecutive unarmed hits build combo stacks for increased punch damage.

adaptations.name: unarmed-disarm
adaptations.expectation: Bare-hand hits can knock the target's held item to the ground.

adaptations.name: unarmed-glass-cannon
adaptations.expectation: Bonus unarmed damage the lower your armor value is.

adaptations.name: unarmed-grapple
adaptations.expectation: Sneak-punch a target to grab it, then hurl it where you look.

adaptations.name: unarmed-iron-fists
adaptations.expectation: Bare fists hit harder and punch through soft blocks faster.

adaptations.name: unarmed-meditation
adaptations.expectation: Meditate while sneaking, still, and empty-handed to slowly build absorption hearts.

adaptations.name: unarmed-power
adaptations.expectation: Improved base unarmed damage.

adaptations.name: unarmed-pressure-point
adaptations.expectation: Bare-hand hits apply stacking slowness, with weakness at higher levels.

adaptations.name: unarmed-second-wind
adaptations.expectation: Bare-hand kills restore hunger and grant a short regeneration burst.

adaptations.name: unarmed-shockwave-clap
adaptations.expectation: Sneak and punch the air to clap a shockwave that knocks back enemies in a cone.

adaptations.name: unarmed-sucker-punch
adaptations.expectation: Sprint punches with an empty main hand deal extra damage.
